Our Expertise at Your Service

Explore our blog for expert insights on data centers, where we share our expertise to empower your digital journey.

01. BEST LOCATIONS

Our data center locations are very attractive for businesses and government units for storing and processing their data and running their applications. Our sites are purposely located very near secure power sources, major business and development areas, and an optimal distance from the country’s borders for increased security.

02. ACCESS TO A GROWING MARKET

Anan offers an excellent opportunity for its customers to build their operations in the ever-growing Israeli and Middle Eastern market, staying ahead of the competition via our secure, high-performance data centers and their connections across this dynamic region.

03. GUARANTEED MAXIMUM POWER

Anan ensures power availability to its sites and customers with contracts for the highest levels available in the country, allowing for economies of scale and maximum computing power benefits for each of its data centers.

04. Top security

Anan’s data centers are underground, providing extremely high levels of physical and cyber-security as well as protection from all forms of broader threats; our customer’s data and applications are safe and secure.
